analysis:
The only change in this PR is a single documentation line at docs/operations/provider-release.md:631. It updates the stated release SDK from 27.0 / Apple Swift 6.4 to SDK 27.2 / Apple Swift 6.4.2 (Xcode 27.2). I read both supplied units (lines 1-454 and 455-904), which are the surrounding context of that change.

The edit adds no code, workflow, secret handling, trust boundary or permission. The release trust model is unchanged: signed annotated tag in master ancestry, secrets scoped per environment, signing separated from R2 staging and publication, and the coordinator registering exact CodeDirectory, binary and metallib hashes. Nothing in the diff weakens T-034, T-054 or T-013 style controls.

The doc says the final recorded SDK must match the selected SDK. That is a build-integrity check, and it is not weakened by the change.

Open question for integration: the diff does not show the workflow, action or script changes that would make SDK 27.2 / Xcode 27.2 the pinned toolchain. The documentation could drift from the real pins, and a checksum-pinned toolchain or runner image change would need its own review. This is not a security regression in the supplied evidence. No threat-model update is needed from this line alone. The existing pointers to the cache and toolchain contracts in docs/developer/build.md remain the places to verify the SDK pin.
